description_sq:
SHITET APARTAMENT 2+1 TEK TIRANA E RE
Ofrojme per shitje apartament te investuar te tipologjise 2+1 ne nje zone teper te kerkuar sic eshte zona e Tiranes se Re.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje nga zonat me te mira te kryeqytetit ne rrugen Irfan Tomini, ne nje pallat te mireadministruar me sistem kapot me ashensor dhe sistem security.
Organizohet ne korridor, 1 soxhorno te bollshme se bashku me ambientin e gatimit, 2 dhoma gjumi, 1 tualet.
Apartamenti eshte i investuar dhe i mobiluar ne menyre bashkohore si ne pajisjet elektroshtepiake, ashtu edhe ne ato hidrosanitare; eshte i shtruar me pllaka; i pajisur me 1 kondicioner ne dhomen e gjumit.Orientimi jug lindje favorizon diell ne apartament dhe drite gjate gjithe kohes.Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Eshte mundesi shume emire si per banim ashtu edhe investim.
Zona ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode pasi ofron larmi sherbimesh, akses me transportin publik dhe privat, shkolla, kopshte, çerdhe, universitete shteterore dhe private, markete, bar kafe, restorante etj.
Zona ofron edhe mundesi parkimi ne zone.
Per nje vizite ne prone mos hezitoni te me kontaktoni!
Faleminderit!
title_en: Apartment - For Sale - Irfan Tomini Street, Tirana(ID: 530191063-1092)
description_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE IN NEW TIRANA We offer for sale a 2+1 type invested apartment in a highly sought after area such as the New Tirana area. The apartment is located in one of the best areas of the capital, on Irfan Tomini Street, in a well-managed building with an elevator and security system. It is organized in the corridor, 1 spacious living room together with the kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom. The apartment is invested and furnished in a contemporary way, both in electrical appliances and in hydrosanitary ones; it is paved with tiles; equipped with 1 air conditioner in the bedroom. Orientation south east favors sun in the apartment and light all the time. It has regular mortgage documentation. It is a very good opportunity for both residence and investment. The area offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life as it offers a variety of services, access to public and private transport, schools, kindergartens, nurseries, state and private universities, markets, coffee bars, restaurants, etc. The area also offers parking in the area. For a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact me! Thank you!
